use.zh-CN: 支撑上臂进行弯举，需另配哑铃或曲杆等负重
use.en: Supports the upper arms for curls using separate dumbbells or a curl bar

caution.zh-CN: 调节座高与垫位，不以底端弹震借力；凳本身不提供阻力
caution.en: Adjust seat and pad position; avoid bouncing at the bottom. The bench supplies no resistance itself

evidenceScope.zh-CN: ACSM支持一般抗阻训练原则；厂商页面只核对本条目的结构，不证明效果或安全性。具体使用以型号手册为准。
evidenceScope.en: ACSM supports general resistance-training principles; the manufacturer page identifies structure only, without establishing efficacy or safety. Consult the model manual.
